scope: Historical slug derivation from the exact archived names supplied by the parent audit; archive UUID/stream bindings are documented separately.

verification.method: Read immutable source with git show, extract only the pure historical function body and execute it with empty/occupied in-memory slug sets.

historicalClientFallback.algorithm:
export function generateSlug(stationName: string): string {
  return stationName
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '') // Remove special characters except spaces and hyphens
    .replace(/\s+/g, '-') // Replace spaces with hyphens
    .replace(/-+/g, '-') // Replace multiple hyphens with single hyphen
    .trim()
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, ''); // Remove leading/trailing hyphens
}

replacementDescription: This commit explicitly replaced the old ASCII-stripping expressions in the bulk/admin/public generators with slugifyStationName and introduced transliteration.
limitations: This proves deterministic base slug derivation for the supplied archived names, not which database row won collision allocation.

The historical server generator appends a numeric suffix when the unsuffixed slug is already used. Archive UUID/stream and current target identity evidence must independently establish ownership; name similarity alone is insufficient.
The separate pre-April-22 station-public-routes.ts inline helper lacked edge-hyphen stripping and differed from this demonstrated bulk generator and frontend link fallback.
This verification did not query or change any database or production system. Archive records and live target eligibility were not independently rechecked in this bounded historical-code subtask.
